name: FC_bench_800
description: FC_bench_800 is a dataset of 800 labeled examples designed to evaluate language model performance on short-answer/classification style tasks. It provides a compact, focused collection intended for quick benchmarking of predictive accuracy across diverse prompts. The benchmark is hosted on Hugging Face and intended for rapid comparisons rather than large-scale evaluation.
reputation: A small, community-hosted benchmark on Hugging Face with limited but growing usage for quick LM checks.
